skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Clear Morning View
skins.content: 0011 New Arrivals/Clear Morning View. Clothes Yu wears when getting ingredients for the reunion dinner. The gold-embroidered top under his cyan jacket billows in the wind. Amidst verdant green, the young man begins his return to his dream of a family gathering.
skins.quote: You need to get to the market as early as possible to pick the best ingredients. Though what he sees in the early morn are things he has seen a hundred times before, he can almost already hear his brothers and sisters rejoicing in their reunion.
